messages:
Rashid (Partner Lead): Quick sync request: GigaNode (HW partner) + NovaWorks (SI) want a joint Datadog marketplace tile for on-prem inference appliances. Needs: lightweight dashboard, OTLP example for airgapped installs (unix socket), and an SI install playbook. Who can own each piece?
Jing (Solutions Eng): I can own the OTLP/unix socket snippet and the trace/span naming recommendations. We should show a minimal collector config that forwards to a Datadog relay in the customer's network.
Asha (Docs): I'll draft the marketplace blurb and the SI playbook steps. Need the dashboard panels list and a short privacy blurb for EU/UK/APAC. Avoid mentioning "customer text" directly.
NovaWorks (SI): From the SI side: installers will want an automated script and an example systemd unit. Also we need a short troubleshooting checklist for TLS and HSM integration when customers use KMS.
Marta (Legal): Heads-up: any marketplace copy that suggests data leaves customer premises needs to be explicit about optional routing and consent. Also embargo window for the joint press is 2 weeks. Please flag any public screenshots that include sample customer IDs.
Jing (Solutions Eng): Draft otelcol config (unix socket source -> file export to relay):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: { endpoint: "/var/run/otel/otlp.sock" }
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/tmp/otlp-forward.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```
Jing (Solutions Eng): Also example span emitted by inference runtime: `span.name = "inference.generate"`, attributes: `model.name`, `tokens.in`, `tokens.out`, `fallback.reason` - useful for the dashboard.
Asha (Docs): Dashboard panel shortlist for compact tile: 1) P50/P95 token latency per model, 2) Model fallback rate + top fallback reasons, 3) Trace error heatmap (by route), 4) Active sessions gauge (optional). We'll keep it to 3 panels on the tile UI and link to full dashboard in the SI playbook.
NovaWorks (SI): We'll prepare the automated installer script and test it in airgapped lab. ETA: 3 business days. We need a sample datadog relay config for the lab.
Rashid (Partner Lead): Plan: Jing -> OTLP + span guidance (tomorrow AM), Asha -> tile copy + screenshots (tomorrow noon), NovaWorks -> installer + relay sample (EOD + lab test), Marta -> legal signoff (48h after drafts). After signoff we submit to Datadog marketplace and schedule the embargoed co-announce.
deploy-bot: Notice: marketplace-preview build #514 passed for branch `marketplace/giganode-novaworks` - preview: https://redwood.internal/preview/514
Asha (Docs): Preview renders, but screenshots include a synthetic trace id. Marta, I masked the ids and added a privacy note.
Marta (Legal): Looks ok. Please ensure the docs include the optionality: "Customers can choose to forward telemetry to Datadog or retain on-premises."
Rashid (Partner Lead): Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate tasks into the PR and tag reviewers. :shipit:
